description: Rewrite all modifiable components (Navbar, Hero, About, Work, Experience, Testimonials, AuroraBackground, ParticleField) and layout/page to use the exact HTML structure and class names from the reference file. Use the content data from content/ files.
steps: 1. Rewrite app/layout.tsx: Keep fonts (Space Grotesk, Inter, JetBrains Mono), metadata, viewport. Remove Splash and CustomCursor imports/usage. Keep AuroraBackground and ParticleField. Remove Navbar and Footer from layout (they'll be in page.tsx or kept in layout if needed by Skills/Contact/Footer). Actually keep Navbar in layout but it will be rewritten. Keep Footer in layout. The body should use font variables. Add the 'wrap' class div structure from the HTML reference.

2. Rewrite components/effects/AuroraBackground.tsx: Render a <div className='cosmos' /> that is fixed fullscreen background matching the HTML .cosmos class (fixed inset-0 with radial gradients defined in CSS).

3. Rewrite components/effects/ParticleField.tsx: Use the EXACT starfield JS from the HTML reference - 220 stars, scroll parallax (scrollY * star.speed * 0.15), mouse parallax ((mx-0.5)*30 for x, (my-0.5)*20 for y), warm pink-white radial gradient rendering (rgb 255,230,255), size distribution (65% tiny 0.3-0.8r, 25% medium 0.7-1.3r, 10% large 1.2-2r), glow radius = r*5. The canvas should be fixed fullscreen with z-index between cosmos and content.

4. Rewrite components/Navbar.tsx: Use the HTML nav structure exactly - <nav class='nav'><div class='nav-inner'> with .logo (containing .logo-mark span + 'Vineet' text), .nav-links (About, Projects, Experience, Contact links), .nav-cta button ('Let's talk' with arrow). Add scroll detection to add 'scrolled' class. Include mobile toggle with .nav-toggle class.

5. Rewrite components/sections/Hero.tsx: Use exact HTML hero structure - <section class='hero' id='top'><div class='hero-grid'> with left column containing .eyebrow (with .dot span + text), h1.hero-title with .accent-text span, .hero-sub paragraph, typewriter div, .hero-cta div with .btn.btn-primary and .btn.btn-ghost buttons. Right column: .orbit-stage with three .orbit-ring divs (r1/r2/r3) and .planet. Import and use the existing Typewriter component.

6. Rewrite components/sections/About.tsx: Use exact HTML about structure - section with .section-head (.section-tag + h2 + .section-sub), .about-grid with .about-portrait (gradient placeholder + .badge) and .about-body (paragraphs from profile.bio + .stats grid with .stat items showing 3+/20+/infinity values).

7. Rewrite components/sections/Work.tsx: Use exact HTML projects structure - section with .section-head, .projects grid containing .project articles (with .project.featured for first item). Each project has .project-visual (with .glyph circle, .tag span, .pnum number), .project-body (h3 title, p description, .stack div with tech spans). Use data from content/projects.ts.

8. Rewrite components/sections/Experience.tsx: Use exact HTML timeline structure - section with .section-head, .timeline div containing .tl-item articles. Each item has .tl-date, .tl-title, .tl-company, .tl-desc. Use data from content/experience.ts.

9. Rewrite components/sections/Testimonials.tsx: Use exact HTML quotes structure - section with .section-head, .quotes grid containing .quote articles. Each quote has blockquote with italic text, .quote-by div with .av (gradient circle), .who span, .role span. Use data from content/testimonials.ts.

10. Update app/page.tsx: Render sections in order - Hero, About, Work, Skills (unchanged), Experience, Testimonials, Contact (unchanged). Wrap in appropriate container. Add scroll-reveal class 'reveal' to sections that need it (About, Work, Experience, Testimonials).

11. Add IntersectionObserver-based scroll reveal: Create a small client component or useEffect in page/layout that observes .reveal elements and adds .in class when they enter viewport (matching the HTML reference's reveal behavior).
acceptance_criteria: All rewritten components use the exact HTML class names from the reference (.nav, .hero, .hero-grid, .about-grid, .projects, .timeline, .quotes, etc.)
The Typewriter component is imported and used in Hero (not reimplemented)
Skills.tsx, Contact.tsx, Footer.tsx, and Typewriter.tsx are NOT modified
Content data from content/ files is used where appropriate
ParticleField renders 220 stars with scroll+mouse parallax and pink-white gradient glow
npx next build succeeds without errors
The scroll reveal (.reveal/.reveal.in) is implemented via IntersectionObserver
